Remember: crosswalks, bridges, intersections, tracks.","fact_ids":["sec07-F02"]}},"recap":null,"must_match_card_back":"Nothing may park, stop, or stand idling roadside of a parked car, on sidewalks or crosswalks, inside intersections, between safety zones and curbs or within thirty feet opposite their ends, beside excavations that block traffic, on bridges, elevated spans, tunnels, rails, or where signs ban stopping.","must_match_memory_hook":"crosswalks, bridges, intersections, tracks","tone":"coach","pacing":"standard","repeat_count":1,"pause_after_ms":800,"pronunciation":[],"visual_sync":[],"source_ref":{"ref":"src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook","tier":"official","url":null,"pdf_page":48,"printed_page":"42","page_map_id":"src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0048"},"fact_ids":["sec07-F02"],"visual_route":null,"image_asset_id":null},{"script_id":"script.sec07-card-sec07-F03","card_id":"sec07-card-sec07-F03","module_id":"sec07-m01","unit_id":"sec07-u01","is_recap":false,"voice":"narrated","mode":"memory_hook","segments":{"question":{"lead_in":"Here is your card.","text":"Where may a vehicle never park or stand, even with someone inside?"},"think_ref":"sec07-think","recall_pause_ms":3000,"answer":{"lead_in":"Here is the answer.","text":"Occupied or not, vehicles never park or stand ahead of driveways, within fifteen feet of hydrants, within twenty feet of intersection crosswalks, within thirty feet before roadside signals and signs, within twenty feet of fire-station doors or seventy-five feet across from them, or where signs ban parking or standing."},"teaching":{"text":"Whether or not someone is inside, never park or stand in front of driveways or too close to hydrants, crosswalks, signals, or fire stations. Remember: hydrants, driveways, fire stations.","fact_ids":["sec07-F03"]}},"recap":null,"must_match_card_back":"Occupied or not, vehicles never park or stand ahead of driveways, within fifteen feet of hydrants, within twenty feet of intersection crosswalks, within thirty feet before roadside signals and signs, within twenty feet of fire-station doors or seventy-five feet across from them, or where signs ban parking or standing.","must_match_memory_hook":"hydrants, driveways, fire stations","tone":"coach","pacing":"standard","repeat_count":1,"pause_after_ms":800,"pronunciation":[],"visual_sync":[],"source_ref":{"ref":"src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook","tier":"official","url":null,"pdf_page":48,"printed_page":"42","page_map_id":"src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0048"},"fact_ids":["sec07-F03"],"visual_route":null,"image_asset_id":null},{"script_id":"script.sec07-card-sec07-F04","card_id":"sec07-card-sec07-F04","module_id":"sec07-m01","unit_id":"sec07-u01","is_recap":false,"voice":"narrated","mode":"memory_hook","segments":{"question":{"lead_in":"Here is your card.","text":"Where is parking alone banned, and how must you park on a rural highway?"},"think_ref":"sec07-think","recall_pause_ms":3000,"answer":{"lead_in":"Here is the answer.","text":"Parking alone is further banned within fifty feet of rails and where signs ban it, rural highways demand off-road parking or else passing room plus two-hundred-foot visibility both ways with night lights or dim headlamps, and bicycles may rest on sidewalks that stay passable."},"teaching":{"text":"Never park within fifty feet of rails, and on rural highways park off the road or leave passing room you can see from both ways.
